extracted.name: Sangria by the Pros
extracted.description: Make sangria like a professional with brandy, red wine, soda, juice, and lots of fruit. This recipe is from a bartender with 20 years of experience.
ingredient_lines: 1 medium all purpose apples, pared, cored and sliced
1 (12 ounce) can lemon-lime soda to taste
instruction_lines: Slice orange, lemon, and lime into thin rounds. Place the sliced citrus in a pitcher with apples, cherries, and pineapple.
Pour in brandy and refrigerate for 2 hours or more. Chill the bottle of red wine, lemon-lime soda, and orange juice at the same time.
Gently crush the fruits with a spoon, then stir in red wine, lemon-lime soda, and orange juice. Add additional brandy or orange juice to taste.
